## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Running the skill on a seeded bug produces a schema-valid evidence ledger...

The system SHALL ensure that running the skill on a seeded bug produces a schema-valid evidence ledger with at least one control fact and a computed matrix.

#### Scenario: Running the skill on a seeded bug produces a schema-valid evidence ledger...

WHEN `rewrite-debugging-skill-around-evidence-ledger` is implemented
THEN Running the skill on a seeded bug produces a schema-valid evidence ledger with at least one control fact and a computed matrix.

### Requirement: A behavioural skill test under skills/tests/debugging-and-error-recovery/...

The system SHALL ensure that a behavioural skill test under skills/tests/debugging-and-error-recovery/ fails if the skill proposes a root cause before recording at least one control fact.

#### Scenario: A behavioural skill test under skills/tests/debugging-and-error-recovery/...

WHEN `rewrite-debugging-skill-around-evidence-ledger` is implemented
THEN A behavioural skill test under skills/tests/debugging-and-error-recovery/ fails if the skill proposes a root cause before recording at least one control fact.

### Requirement: A reproduction that does not reproduce the recorded strongest signal is...

The system SHALL ensure that a reproduction that does not reproduce the recorded strongest signal is marked rejected in the ledger and is never cited as evidence.

#### Scenario: A reproduction that does not reproduce the recorded strongest signal is...

WHEN `rewrite-debugging-skill-around-evidence-ledger` is implemented
THEN A reproduction that does not reproduce the recorded strongest signal is marked rejected in the ledger and is never cited as evidence.

### Requirement: The skill text orders code reading after fact gathering and control...

The system SHALL ensure that the skill text orders code reading after fact gathering and control establishment, and descends a layer only when every current signal is weak.

#### Scenario: The skill text orders code reading after fact gathering and control...

WHEN `rewrite-debugging-skill-around-evidence-ledger` is implemented
THEN The skill text orders code reading after fact gathering and control establishment, and descends a layer only when every current signal is weak.
